subject: Application - Regional Head Sales
body:
I am writing to express my interest in the Regional Head – Sales position. Over the last 12 years, I have managed sales operations across Maharashtra, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh, with responsibility for dealer networks, key accounts and teams of up to 38 people. At Voltara Consumer Systems, I grew the western region revenue from approximately INR 42 crore to INR 71 crore in three years while reducing channel receivables by 18%. I believe my experience in consumer electronics and multi-city sales management could be relevant to Nexora's expansion plans.

I have attached my detailed profile and cover letter. I would appreciate an opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to the organization.

Regards,
Anirudh Menon
+91 98204 77126
linkedin.com/in/anirudh-menon

subject: Relocation / Application
body: Hello, I am currently working as a senior procurement analyst in Zagreb and planning to move to Pune in early November 2026 because of family relocation. I have 7 years of experience in electronics procurement and vendor management and would like to know if my profile can be considered for relevant positions at Nexora. Could you also clarify whether the company accepts candidates serving a 60-day notice and whether any relocation or visa documentation is required for an overseas applicant? I hold an Indian OCI card but am presently employed outside India.

subject: Resume
body: I took a career break of almost four years after leaving my accounting role in 2022 to take care of my parents. During the break I completed an advanced Excel and GST accounting course and recently started doing part-time bookkeeping for two small businesses in Nashik. I am now looking to return to full-time employment as an accountant or finance executive. I understand the gap may need explanation, so I wanted to mention it upfront rather than leave it unexplained on my CV.

subject: Portfolio
body: Hi, I am applying for a digital marketing/design opportunity. Instead of attaching a traditional CV, I have shared my work portfolio here: https://meherjoshi.myportfolio.com and my campaign work is at https://github.com/meherjoshi-marketing. Most of my work has been for retail and consumer brands, including product launches, social media creatives and email campaigns. Please let me know if the links are accessible from your side.

subject: Feedback regarding interview
body: Hi HR team, I attended the second round for the Store Manager position on 8 September and received the rejection email yesterday. I respect the decision, but if possible could you share one or two areas where my interview or experience was not suitable? I am applying for similar retail leadership roles and the feedback would genuinely help me improve.

subject: Interview link not opening
body: My interview for Service Engineer is scheduled today at 3:30 PM. The Teams link from the previous email keeps showing 'meeting not found'. I tried from my laptop and phone. Please confirm whether there is another link or reporting location if the online interview cannot be fixed. I am available on 97681 44320.

subject: Fwd: Candidate profile - Warehouse Supervisor
body:
Hi HR,

Forwarding the CV of a candidate I interviewed informally through my previous network. We have been struggling to find someone with warehouse and dispatch experience for the Bhiwandi operation. Please have the recruitment team screen him if the position is still open.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Operations

subject: Urgent - new position approval
body: We need approval to open one additional Customer Support Executive position for the Hyderabad service centre. Current ticket volume has increased since August and two team members are covering evening shifts repeatedly. Proposed CTC range is 3.6-4.2 LPA. JD is attached for review. Please approve the requisition so Talent Acquisition can start sourcing this week.

subject: Transfer request
body: Hi, I wanted to check if there is a possibility of transferring from Ahmedabad to Pune after December. My spouse has moved there and I am trying to understand whether an internal transfer is possible before I make any personal arrangements. I have completed 2 years in the service coordination team and my performance reviews have been consistent. Please advise the process.

subject: Query - medical claim / PF
body: Could someone please confirm why my medical reimbursement for July is still showing pending and whether my PF UAN KYC has been approved? I submitted the Aadhaar and bank details last month. Also need to know where I can download the current Form 16. If these are separate teams, please forward accordingly.

subject: Long leave request
body: I would like to formally request maternity leave starting 14 December 2026. I have discussed the tentative dates with my reporting manager, and she asked me to submit the request to HR. Please let me know the required medical documents and the process for adding the leave period in the employee portal. I may also need to use my available leave immediately before the maternity leave starts.

subject: Exit formalities
body: My last working day was 16 October and I have already handed over the laptop and access card to the IT desk. Security is asking for an asset clearance reference and my new employer is asking for a no-dues confirmation. Can HR please confirm if anything is still pending from my side?

subject: Certification reimbursement
body: I completed the Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst certification this month, which was discussed with my manager before registration. The exam and preparation expenses came to INR 18,750. I have attached the payment receipts and certificate. Please let me know if I need to raise this through any separate reimbursement portal.

subject: Joining query
body: Hi HR, joining on 2 Nov as Service Technician. Will laptop be given on day 1 or should I bring my own? Also please confirm whether salary account needs to be opened with a particular bank and where I should submit the cancelled cheque. I haven't received the official email ID details yet.

subject: College project / completion certificate
body: Good afternoon. I completed my six-month internship with the customer experience team in September and my college requires an internship completion certificate along with a short recommendation letter from the organization. My project was on analysing repeat customer complaints for small appliances. I had submitted the final report to Mr. Sameer Dutta on 28 September. Could HR please advise when these documents can be issued?

subject: Is this genuine?
body: I received an offer letter yesterday from someone claiming to be from Nexora recruitment. They asked me to pay INR 4,500 for a background verification kit before the joining date. The email came from nexora-careers@consultmail.in. I have not paid anything. Please confirm whether this recruitment communication is genuine and whether the person is actually associated with your company.

subject: Contract technical resources
body: We provide contract technicians for consumer electronics installation and after-sales support in Mumbai and Thane. I have personally handled field-service operations for brands including air conditioners, refrigerators and televisions. If Nexora is considering temporary service engineers or project-based technical manpower for the winter campaign, I would be happy to discuss availability, commercial terms and onboarding requirements.

subject: job hai kya?
body: Sir job hai kya in Mumbai for sales or store? 6 yrs exp hai.

subject: Salary slip issue
body: My September salary credited is lower than expected by around INR 6,800. In the payslip, TDS appears twice and the variable allowance is missing. I have checked with my manager and there was no change communicated to me. Can payroll please check and correct the slip?

subject: Resume - Customer Experience
body: I am currently working in Bengaluru with an online home-appliance marketplace and have 5 years of experience handling escalations, service coordination and customer retention. I am interested in moving into a Customer Experience role with a manufacturer rather than continuing in marketplace operations. My CV is attached. I can join after a 45-day notice period.

subject: Application
body: I have 8 years of experience in appliance sales, including distributor management and institutional accounts in Rajasthan. I am currently based in Jaipur but looking at Mumbai or Ahmedabad opportunities. Please consider my profile for Sales Manager or Area Sales Manager openings. I have attached the CV and recent performance sheet.

subject: Query
body: I finished my B.Com in 2018 and then worked in retail operations for two years. Since 2021 I have been running a small family business, but I now want to return to employment. I recently completed a diploma in supply chain management. Would a warehouse coordinator or inventory role be considered even though my recent experience is self-employment?

subject: work
body:
Portfolio: https://yashagarwal.dev
GitHub: https://github.com/yash-a-agarwal

I have built order tracking dashboards, a warranty-ticket API and a small inventory forecasting application. I am looking for software developer or internal tools opportunities. I have not attached a conventional CV because most of my recent work is available through the links above.

subject: Regarding yesterday's interview
body: Thanks for informing me about the outcome. I wanted to ask whether the rejection was mainly because of the technical round or because another candidate had more relevant experience. I don't want to challenge the decision, just trying to understand where I fell short. The interviewer mentioned my Excel test was acceptable but my ERP exposure was limited.

subject: Urgent
body: I am at the Pune office address mentioned in the interview mail but security says there is no interview scheduled under my name. Interview was 11 AM today for technician role. Please check urgently.

subject: Fwd: CV for service team
body:
Forwarding a profile received from a former colleague. Candidate has 4 years of field service experience and currently works around Indore. We have one technician opening expected next month. Please see if Talent Acquisition can keep this profile in the pipeline.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Rajat Solanki
Subject: Technician CV
Attached for your reference.

subject: Manpower requirement - Delhi
body: Our Delhi service centre requires two additional installation technicians for the next quarter. One position should be experienced in split AC installation and the other should be capable of handling refrigerators and washing machines. Please confirm the approval route and whether HR can reuse the existing technician JD or wants a revised requisition.

subject: Promotion discussion
body: I have completed three years as Senior Executive - Customer Support and would like to understand the criteria and timeline for moving to Team Leader. I have consistently met the monthly quality target and have been handling escalations since February. Could HR advise whether promotion reviews are annual or manager initiated?

subject: Insurance enrollment
body: My spouse was added to my family recently and I missed the insurance enrollment window because I was travelling for work. Is there a way to add her now under the corporate medical policy? I can provide the marriage certificate and other documents. Also please let me know if any additional premium will be deducted.

subject: Sabbatical request
body: I am requesting a six-month sabbatical from 1 January 2027 due to an educational programme that requires full-time attendance. I have already spoken with my manager and we can complete the handover before December end. Please let me know the formal application process and whether the period will affect my continuity of service.

subject: No dues?
body: I returned the laptop, headset and access card last Friday. Accounts says they are waiting for HR clearance before processing my final settlement. Can someone confirm if there is any remaining item against my employee ID?

subject: Course reimbursement - urgent
body: I enrolled in a six-week Advanced Negotiation programme after my reporting manager recommended it for my procurement role. The invoice is in my name and payment was made personally because the course provider did not accept company billing. I was told training reimbursement is possible. Please confirm the documentation needed before I submit the claim.

subject: Joining tomorrow
body: Joining tomorrow for warehouse supervisor position. Where do I collect ID card and laptop? Also bank account details form not received.

subject: Recommendation
body: I completed my summer internship with Nexora's digital marketing team at the Mumbai office on 30 June 2026. My college, St. Xavier's College Ahmedabad, is asking for a recommendation letter for my final placement applications. My internship completion certificate was already issued. Could HR provide a brief recommendation based on my internship work?

subject: Nexora job offer received
body: I received a WhatsApp message offering me a position as 'Senior Operations Officer - Nexora Mumbai'. They asked for my Aadhaar card and a refundable registration deposit. The contact number is +91 90112 66381. I am attaching the screenshot because I am unsure whether this is a genuine recruitment drive.

subject: Service manpower proposal
body: We are an independent field-service consultancy with technicians across Surat, Vadodara and Ahmedabad. Our engineers can be deployed on a monthly or per-job basis for appliance installation and breakdown visits. If your service network is facing seasonal capacity issues, I can share manpower availability and commercial rates. We also manage background verification and attendance tracking.

subject: Job
body: Mumbai me part time job hai kya? Evening shift chalega.

subject: Payroll query
body: October payslip has professional tax of INR 250 but the same amount seems to have been deducted in September as well despite my salary revision being effective from October. Please check whether the deduction is correct. Also the TDS amount differs from the payroll statement I received last month.

subject: CV - Accounts
body: I am applying for an Accounts Executive role. I have handled vendor invoices, bank reconciliation, GST entries and monthly closing for a logistics company in Kochi. I am moving to Pune in December and would prefer an opportunity there. Notice period is 30 days.

subject: Job opportunity
body: After 14 years in telecom field operations, I am looking to move into consumer electronics service management. I have managed teams across Kerala and Tamil Nadu and currently lead approximately 60 field technicians. I understand my sector is different, but the operational requirements are quite similar. Please keep my profile in consideration for a service operations leadership role.

subject: Fwd: Resume
body: Forwarding my cousin's CV as discussed with Mr. Rakesh from the Noida sales team. She has two years of inside-sales experience and is looking for a Mumbai opportunity. Please don't consider this a formal referral if the position isn't open; just wanted to check whether HR can review her profile.

subject: Need clarification
body: I applied for the Store Manager opening last month and noticed the job page is still active. My application status shows 'under review' for more than three weeks. I have another offer with a response deadline next Tuesday, so could someone confirm whether my application is still being considered?

subject: Resume + quotation
body: Please find attached my resume for the Sales Executive position. Separately, my current employer also supplies POS printers and barcode scanners to retailers. I have attached our quotation in case Nexora has any requirement. I hope it is okay to send both together. I am available for an interview in Bengaluru after 5 PM on weekdays.

subject: Customer escalation + hiring question
body: Hi HR, I need to forward a customer escalation to the service team because their refrigerator has been pending for 11 days. Separately, my brother is looking for a technician job and I have attached his CV. Please route the customer matter to the right person and let me know if his profile can be considered for the next technician batch.

subject: Senior position
body: I am currently a Regional Business Manager with 10 years of experience across consumer durables and retail distribution. My responsibilities include forecasting, distributor appointments, modern trade negotiations and a team of 24 sales officers. I am interested in leadership opportunities in Maharashtra or Gujarat. Please find my profile attached for consideration.

subject: Moving to Mumbai
body: I am relocating from Chennai to Mumbai in December because my spouse has accepted a position there. I currently work as an HR Executive and have 4.5 years of experience in recruitment, employee documentation and onboarding. Could you tell me if internal or external HR vacancies are available in Mumbai, and whether the notice period can be negotiated from 60 to 30 days?

subject: Regarding job
body: I completed diploma in mechanical in 2019, worked as technician till 2023, then prepared for government exams. Now I want to restart private job. I am okay with field work and shifts. Please let me know if there is any technician/service opening around Pune.

subject: UX work
body: Sharing my product design portfolio for consideration: https://tanyamehra.design. I have designed mobile service-booking flows, warranty registration screens and technician dashboards for two SaaS companies. I am particularly interested in UX or product design roles involving customer-service products. My Behance projects are also linked from the portfolio.

subject: Interview update
body: I attended the final interview for the warehouse supervisor vacancy on 21 October. The recruiter had mentioned I would receive an update within a week. I understand hiring can take time, but could you please confirm whether the position has been filled? I am asking because I need to plan my notice period at my current company.

subject: Fwd: candidate
body: Forwarding the CV of a former colleague who has worked in appliance repair for 9 years. Our Nagpur vendor is currently short of technicians, so I thought HR might want to keep this profile for future hiring. Please advise if employee referrals need to be submitted through the portal only.

subject: Additional headcount
body: The Bengaluru service centre is currently operating with 14 technicians against an approved strength of 17. Two additional people are needed because of increased installation volume. I have attached a draft JD based on the previous hiring cycle. Please confirm if Finance approval is also required before HR can post the vacancy.

subject: Increment
body: I wanted to check whether the annual increment review for the operations team has been completed. My manager mentioned that my rating was submitted in August but I have not received any communication about the revised salary. Please let me know if there is a standard timeline for the increment letters.

subject: PF KYC
body: My UAN portal is showing the employer name but bank KYC is still marked pending. I submitted the cancelled cheque and PAN copy in July. Please check if HR needs another copy or if the approval is pending with the PF team.

subject: Leave request
body: I need to request paternity leave for 10 working days starting 9 November following the birth of my child. My manager is already aware and the team handover is planned. Please confirm if any hospital/birth documentation is required along with the application.

subject: Final settlement
body: I resigned from the service engineering team and my relieving date was 3 October. I returned the company phone and toolkit to the Mumbai service office. My final settlement email mentions an asset clearance pending, but I have no idea which item is outstanding. Could HR share the pending item so I can close it?

subject: Training
body: I am planning to attend a three-day SAP MM workshop in December because I handle purchase orders and vendor coordination. The fee is INR 11,800. My manager has verbally approved the training. Can I claim the amount after completion, and do I need HR approval before registering?

subject: Joining formalities
body: Hi, I have accepted the offer for Sales Executive and my joining date is 16 November. I received the offer but no instructions about reporting time, ID proof, salary account or whether I should bring original certificates. Please send the joining checklist if available.

subject: Internship certificate
body: My internship ended on 12 August but I have not yet received the completion certificate. The college submission deadline is 5 November. I worked with the Hyderabad customer support team under Mr. Dinesh Rao. Could you please check the status?

subject: Offer verification
body: Someone called me saying they are recruiting for Nexora and asked me to send a scanned passport and pay for a 'joining insurance'. Before sharing anything, I wanted to verify if Nexora has a recruitment process involving such payments. I applied for a Service Engineer position through a job portal last week.

subject: Contract recruitment support
body: We support short-term hiring for warehouse, customer support and field-service positions. Our current database has candidates in Pune, Mumbai and Hyderabad who can join within 15 days. If Nexora needs temporary recruitment support for the year-end demand, I can arrange a call with our account manager and share our fee structure.

subject: walk in?
body: Nexora me sales job ke liye walk in interview hai kya? I can come today.

subject: Salary correction
body: There seems to be a mistake in my October salary. Basic pay is correct but the transport allowance has been deducted although I have not opted out of the allowance. Also TDS is approximately INR 2,000 higher than last month without a corresponding change in taxable salary. Please recheck the payroll calculation and let me know if a revised payslip will be issued.
